name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAuxC_le
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (L : Nat),
      (∀ (x : ν), Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) x → LE.le.{0} (c x) L) →
        ∀ (f : Nat) (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
          DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Good N U →
            LE.le.{0} f (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) 1) →
              LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAuxC N c f U)
                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} f
                    (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.roundB
                      (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N))
                      (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) L)))

theorem ffAuxC_le (hN : N.Ok) (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ x ∈ N.nodes, c x ≤ L) :
    ∀ (f : ℕ) (U : List (ν × ν)), N.Good U → f ≤ N.arcs.length + 1 →
      N.ffAuxC c f U ≤ 1 + f * roundB N.nodes.length N.arcs.length L
  | 0, _, _, _ => by simp [ffAuxC]
  | f + 1, U, hU, hf => by
      simp only [ffAuxC]
      have hfuel : natC (f + 1) ≤ 2 * N.arcs.length + 5 := by
        have := natC_le_linear (f + 1); omega
      have hsub : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ N.arcs := fun a ha => hU.flow.sub a (List.mem_toFinset.mpr ha)
      have hm := N.good_length_le U hU
      have h1 := N.seenC_le c hN L hL U hsub hm
      have h2 := N.memNC_le c L hL (N.seen U) N.t (N.seen_subset U hN.s_mem) hN.t_mem
      have h2' := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (1 + 2 * L) (N.seen_length_le U hN)
      unfold roundB
      split_ifs with ht
      · have h3 := N.augPathC_le c hN L hL U hsub hm ht
        have h4 := N.augmentC_le c hN L hL U hsub hm (N.augPath U) (N.augPath_subset U hN)
          (N.augPath_length_le U hN ht)
        have h5 := ffAuxC_le hN L hL f _ (N.good_augment hN U hU ht) (by omega)
        unfold roundB at h5
        nlinarith
      · nlinarith
